notes:
Account summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B). Evaluating Redwood hosted API for quick integration (chat+embeddings) then plans to move to Dedicated for predictable unit costs and throughput. Primary ask: predictable $/req and controls to keep user-facing latency p95 < 150ms.

Key technical requirements and preferences:
- Workloads: customer-facing chat (sessions with context up to 2k tokens), embeddings for search and reranking of docs, periodic batch reranks.
- Targets: p95 latency target 120-150ms for chat; steady-state throughput ~120-180 reqs/s for peak; cost sensitivity high (target ARR/unit economics to be ~<$0.002 per request equivalent).
- Models: prefer open chat model variants (Llama-2 style) or Redwood-curated models; want ability to route to smaller cheaper model for background tasks (rerank/embeddings).
- Deployment constraints: start on Hosted (fast dev loop), Dedicated for production (VPC, dedicated GPU pool), require SOC2 + SSO/SAML + audit logging. Some EU customers require data residency discussions.

POC & cost workshop notes:
- POC scope: 2-week hosted POC mirroring 10k DAU sample traces; evaluate batching, KV/prefix caching on repeated prompts, and quantization profiles to reduce GPU memory and cost.
- Cost workshop focus items: batching strategy (dynamic batching + request shaping), prefix/KV caching opportunities across sessions, sequence-length distribution analysis, model quantization options (int8 / Q4_0 / Q2_K_M variants), and per-route unit economics.
- SE suggested experiments: measure token-level CPU/GPU cost with/without KV cache; simulate 2ms additional batching latency window to increase token throughput and compare RU costs; test int8 quantization on candidate model for quality regression (A/B on sample prompts).
- Early observations: Hosted API demo had acceptable latency at pilot scale but projected monthly cost higher than target when scaled to full customer base. Dedicated shows potential 35-50% cost reduction under steady throughput but requires 6-9 month commit for best pricing.

Stakeholder quotes / pull-through:
- "Need predictable $/req — procurement won't accept variable spikes without committed lanes." — CTO (Anand Rao)
- Product lead: "If we can get batching and cache to cut calls by 40% we're comfortable moving to Dedicated." 

Next steps (short):
- Run 2-week hosted POC with profiling hooks (batch sizes, KV hit rate, token counts) — SE to provide test harness.
- Cost optimization workshop w/ Redwood Optimize + SE (deep dive on quantization profiles, batch windows, caching rules).
- Produce Dedicated sizing + pricing proposal after POC shows sustained throughput and cache hit improvements.
